# FG-REPO-0013

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 400 |
| 重大度 | info |
| Runbook | なし |
| 発生させるテスト | `a_protected_ref_pattern_breaking_the_rules_is_rejected` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: 保護ブランチの規則が正しくありません。refs/heads/ か refs/tags/ で始まる 255 バイトまでのパターンで、* は最後の部分に 1 つだけ使えます。
- en: The protected branch rule is not valid. Use a pattern of up to 255 bytes that starts with refs/heads/ or refs/tags/, with at most one '*' in its last part.
- id: Aturan branch terlindungi tidak valid. Gunakan pola hingga 255 byte yang diawali refs/heads/ atau refs/tags/, dengan paling banyak satu '*' di bagian terakhirnya.

## 原因 (cause)

A protected ref rule (forge.protected_refs, ADR-0008) broke a rule before anything was written. The pattern (forge_core RefPattern::parse) is longer than 255 bytes, does not start with refs/heads/ or refs/tags/, has more than one '*' or a '*' outside its last path component, or, with the '*' read as an ordinary character, breaks git's check-ref-format rules (the rules of RefName, including forge's no-leading-'-' rule). Protected ref changes (step D4 MR5) also refuse a pattern that equals an existing rule of the project ignoring case, and a 101st rule of one project.

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

The log event carries `reason`: too_long (with `len`, in bytes), prefix, wildcard, check_ref_format (with `rule`, the RefName rule that failed: trailing_slash, double_dot, forbidden_character, component_starts_with_dot, ...), duplicate_pattern (another rule of the project has the same pattern ignoring case; the database backstop is the unique index protected_refs_project_pattern on lower(pattern), ASCII case only) or too_many_rules (the project already has 100 rules; this cap is enforced by the application only, the database has no limit). The pattern itself is not logged. The database CHECKs (protected_refs_pattern_prefix, protected_refs_pattern_length) hold only the prefix and length rules; the rest is the parser's job, so a pattern written without RefPattern::parse can pass the database.

## 対処 (fix)

Correct the pattern named by `reason`: start it with refs/heads/ or refs/tags/, keep it within 255 bytes, use at most one '*' and only in the last part (refs/heads/release/*), or change the existing rule instead of adding a duplicate; remove unused rules before adding more than 100.
